meta.name: Aarya 2020
meta.description:
When her world suddenly turns upside down, will Aarya become the very thing she hated? How far will she go to survive and protect her family?

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 19 Jun 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 52 min
Studio: Endemol Shine India · Network: Disney+ Hotstar

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9 | S2 8/8 | S3 8/8

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Tum Mujhpe Bharosa Karti Ho?
videos.overview: Aarya and Tej's family life turns upside down when her brother, Sangram, and their friend, Jawahar, take a dangerous risk to make a quick buck.

videos.title: Aapko Shaq Hai Kisi Par?
videos.overview: Tragedy strikes home. Adding insult to injury, Aarya has to deal with an unforeseen pressure from the police. In the midst of all this, Aarya begins to suspect someone.

videos.title: Kaun Zimmedar Hai?
videos.overview: While the family reels in distress, Jawahar warns Aarya about the danger they all are in. When she visits Sangram in the jail, a shock awaits her.

videos.title: Apne Panje Bahar Nikaalo
videos.overview: Aarya is threatened by an unknown assailant, which ups her worry about her children's safety, who are dealing with their own problems. But she finds an unlikely ally in Daulat.

videos.title: Kaun Chalaega Business?
videos.overview: Danger strikes Aarya and her family once more, and the relentless Khan searches her house yet again. Fed up, Aarya decides to take the bull by the horns and meets Shekhawat.

videos.title: Ek Guru Chahiye
videos.overview: As Aarya dives deep into the business, she faces her first challenge. In the meantime, Khan goes after Hina for information, while Jawahar and Daulat get into a scuffle.

videos.title: Aapki Mummy Don Hai
videos.overview: The worst has happened and Aarya goes looking for Jawahar. Distressed, she informs Shekhawat about a change in plan, only to find him uncaring. How will she keep her kids safe?

videos.title: Grahan Hai Aaj
videos.overview: Aarya shares with Veer and Aru the challenges she has been facing, and promises to end all the suffering with a master plan. Will everything fall into place?

videos.title: Dharm Sankat
videos.overview: Despite losing the case, Khan is adamant to find the truth. As another tragedy strikes and the family is in the depths of despair, Aarya is left with a fresh dilemma.

videos.title: Mujhe Yahaan Se Bhaagna Hai
videos.overview: Forced to return to testify against her family, Aarya is caught in a whirlwind of her bloodied past, the one she has been running away from.

videos.title: An Eye For An Eye
videos.overview: Aarya drowns in the fear of being attacked by her enemies as she tries to find ways to run away from the country. However, someone is keeping an eye on her.

videos.title: Ab Hum Vaapis Jaa Rahe Hain
videos.overview: Aarya's past returns to help her in restoring normalcy, and her plans to escape seem to be taking shape. But an unexpected event may create new obstacles.

videos.title: Sangram Kahaan Hai?
videos.overview: Sangram's disappearance becomes a hurdle to Aarya's plans. Meanwhile, Hina reveals something unpleasant to Aarya.

videos.title: 300 Crore Ka Consignment
videos.overview: As another tragedy shakes her family, Aarya is shocked to find the Rs 300 crore consignment returned to her life.

videos.title: I Hate You, Mom
videos.overview: The Sareen family struggles to stay united. In this true test of time, what will Aarya lose next?

videos.title: Phir Se Panje Baahar Nikaalo
videos.overview: As Hina spirals in her grief, Aarya is pushed to the brink by the Russians and Shekhawat. Will she seek Daulat's help?

videos.title: Isko Mere Raaste Se Hataa Do
videos.overview: When an unexpected outcome shakes her conscience, Aarya realises she can't run away from her reality. A final confrontation turns her into someone she never thought she would be.

videos.title: Kahani Abhi Khatam Nahi Hui Hain
videos.overview: To protect her children, Aarya, the don, aims for complete control of the drug operations. But a story of revenge and Khan's dogged pursuit become insurmountable obstacles.

videos.title: Galti Ki Saza Maut
videos.overview: Aarya faces the impossible choice between protecting her son's love and protecting her family from the Russians. Meanwhile, Sooraj tortures Roop to ensure Aarya's destruction.

videos.title: Sherni Ka Shikar
videos.overview: Dangerous heroin suppliers Nalini Sahiba and Abhimanyu threaten Aarya if the consignment is not retrieved. As Aarya hunts for Sooraj, she struggles with her sons and Khan.

videos.title: Bali Ya Balidaan
videos.overview: Sooraj's quest to find Nandini's remains pushes him to extreme lengths. In the meantime, Veer, Maya, Aarya and Sooraj find themselves bound by revenge and regret.

videos.title: Sherni Ke Shikaar Ka Waqt Aa Gaya Hai
videos.overview: Thanks to the seized consignment, Aarya and Nalini Sahiba end up in the crosshairs of Mikhail, the new Russian boss. Betrayals come to light, and a crucial meeting turns bloody.

videos.title: Khabri Ki Sazaa Maut
videos.overview: Daulat abandons his new life to help Aarya again. Sampat faces Aarya's wrath for shooting Dhruv, but Aru blames her. Nalini Sahiba and Mikhail put Aarya in a tight spot.

videos.title: Aarya Sareen Is An Unfit Mother
videos.overview: The welfare officer finally meets the whole family. However, an unpleasant interruption becomes disastrous. As business and family collide, how will Aarya protect her loved ones?

videos.title: Panje Nikalne Ka Waqt Aa Gaya Hai
videos.overview: Having lost everything she holds dear, Aarya takes an inevitable step. Caught between the Russians, Nalini Sahiba and Khan, how will Aarya redeem herself?
